profile.headline: SWE @ Microsoft
profile.summary: I recently received my Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a minor in Women, Science, and Technology from the Georgia Institute of Technology. I am now working towards a Master of Science degree in Computer Science. I enjoy solving problems through efficient software design specifically in Java, Python, and C#.

positions.title: Information Visualization Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Plan and lead recitations to review class content 
• Answer questions from class forum online
• Hold weekly office hours to help students one on one with course or project questions
• Create and grade homework, project assignments, and exams
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · D3.js · Tableau · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Skills: .NET Framework · Network Resilience · Software Defined Networking · Unit Testing · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Utilized Slack and GitHub APIs to build a slack bot that generates change log messages from pull requests and notifies clients and developers
• Developed a GraphQL API in Golang to query and filter change log messages from a Google Cloud Platform Big Query table and deployed the server using Kubernetes
• Designed a website using React, allowing users to filter, search, and view all change logs for a repository
• Produced a Python and Bash script to automate turning the Big Query database of pull requests into a readable markdown file to easily view complete change logs
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Go (Programming Language) · GraphQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · React.js · Git · Kubernetes

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Wrote, tested, and deployed code improving the Force Level Integrated Analysis Toolset to help the Navy make strategic decisions and evaluate risk utilizing visual analytics in Python, JavaScript, and  TypeScript
•  Utilized Swagger to create API endpoints to support navigation within the website
•  Updated and developed a variety of features within the website for a better user experience with React, Material UI, HTML, and Django
• Managed project progression through Git, Jira, and BitBucket to support agile development
• Produced technical documentation for users and future developers
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · HTML · React.js · Material-UI · Django · Git · Software Deployment · REST APIs · Testing · TypeScript · Agile Development

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: Working as a peer tutor within the community at Georgia Tech allows me to empower student athletes to reach their fullest potential. I aid students in developing personal, content driven academic goals in order to succeed by providing subject centered tutoring depending on the student's needs.

positions.title: Member Services Assistant
positions.description: During my time as a Member Services Assistant at the Campus Recreation Center I oversaw and ensured the success in the facility access database to record member attendance along with answering general department questions regarding available services.

volunteerExperiences.description: Being an officer in the Habitat for Humanity chapter at my high school has been such a rewarding experience and I plan to continue my participation in Habitat after high school.
